invariants.rationale: Cursors in text fields are usually non-negative and represent valid string indices or positions.
Selection start indices in text fields are generally non-negative, aligning with the beginning of a string.
If a selection exists, the selection start should differ from the cursor; otherwise, there is no range selected.
Cursor and selectionStart cannot exceed the text's length, but if text is null, this is not checked.
When there is a selection, the indices should be within text bounds.
